areas.name: Årås naturreservat
areas.rulesSummary: No motor vehicles except on roads; no caravan/camper setup outside parking; no fires; no damage/removal of dead trees, windfalls, living trees or shrubs; no collecting mosses, lichens, insects or fungi except edible fungi; no digging up vascular plants; no unleashed dogs; no introducing species.

protectedAreas.notes: The exact route/reserve intersections should be spatially clipped before runtime import, especially around Struntfiskeboa/Årås and Knätte/Kärnås. Preserve the protected-area rules in section metadata even if some reserve polygons are adjacent rather than on the route line.

dogsLivestockPrivateLand.notes: Ulricehamn local ordinance requires dogs to be leashed on public/equivalent places such as hiking trails and beaches and dog waste to be picked up. Årås reserve forbids unleashed dogs; Kärnås forbids loose dogs; Knätte visit page shows dog restriction. The route crosses rural farmland and villages, and 2024 photo evidence confirms livestock near/on the trail. Keep dogs leashed, close gates, avoid livestock stress and avoid damaging crops.

roadAndSurfaceHazards.notes: This is a road-heavy easy stage: asphalt out of Böne, then smaller gravel/unsealed roads through rural landscape. Expect mixed road walking, limited services and weather exposure. A 2025 E1 field report encountered heavy rain/cold and used a Jogen changing-room building for dry shelter.

waterSafety.notes: Do not treat Böne kyrka as potable water. Varpaledet/Jogen is bathing water, not drinking water; 2025 samples were reported as tjänligt/no bloom but 2026 bathing-season samples were not found on 2026-04-29. Avoid bathing if water is visibly cloudy/discolored from algal bloom. Boat/fishing rules around bathing jetties include no boat mooring at bathing-place jetties, no boat traffic within at least 50 m of installed bathing jetty and no fishing at/near bathing places during May-September.

huntingAndForestry.notes: No current section-9 hunting, forestry closure or route reroute notice was found in checked official trail, municipal or Länsstyrelsen sources. The route crosses private/working rural land, so temporary local signs, active forestry machinery, hunting notices and landowner instructions must be respected.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No section-9-specific closure/reroute was found in official sources or field reports. Naturkartan's trail-wide Västkuststiftelsen QA warning remains relevant: signage/passability may have deficiencies even without a formal closure.

emergency.notes: For emergencies, call 112 and provide exact position/nearest road. Section 9 is road-heavy with several rural road access points, but fixed public transport is weak and Årås/Böne endpoint pickups require planning.

conditionReports.summary: Firsthand E1 hiker reached Böne at 08:00; Böne kyrka was locked and churchyard water was signed not drinkable. Heavy rain and cold conditions were noted. Jogen had a swim changing-room building that provided dry shelter. Near Vållern/Årås mill, a nature-reserve area had a wind shelter. The day was mostly road walking with off-road walking around Årås/Vållern.
conditionReports.confidence: high for May 2025 observed conditions; medium for exact stage boundary because the day continued beyond section 9
conditionReports.importImpact: Mark Böne as no potable water/open church unreliable; model Jogen changing-room only as weather shelter, not overnight shelter; add road-heavy/weather-exposed note; treat Årås services as confirm-before-relying.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official identity, Borås 12 km/3 h/Lätt, Böne-to-Årås endpoint labels, Naturkartan 11.5 km/API/GPX, Borås coordinates, endpoint label contradiction and protected-area source set.
Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 5607244. Confirmed continuous Böne-to-Årås geometry, close OSM/Naturkartan agreement, no Åsundenleden/Redvägsleden overlap and 311 m Änglaleden overlap.

Found Böne church/parking, Knätte church, Varpaledet bathing/parking, Struntfiskeboa shelter/firepit, Årås parking/cafe/hostel and suppression decisions for Redvägsleden/off-section items and unconfirmed public drinking water.

Confirmed weak fixed-route access at both endpoints. Böne and Årås are practical mainly by parking/drop-off or pre-booked Västtrafik Närtrafik; Dalum is the nearest useful fixed bus for Böne and Årås fixed bus options are 10 km+ away.

Found 2025 firsthand E1 report with no potable Böne water, church locked, heavy rain, Jogen changing-room dry shelter, wind shelter near Vållern/Årås and mostly road walking; older Komoot and 2024 Flickr reports support service and rural/livestock caveats.
Confirmed Årås reserve rules, Ulricehamn local ordinance camping/dog restrictions, Varpaledet/Jogen water-quality caveats, dynamic fire status and no current official section-9 closure/reroute.

importReadiness.summary: Section 9 has enough official source, GPX/API/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field-report and rules/safety evidence for normalization. It is not ready for direct runtime import because endpoint naming/aliases must be deduplicated, fixed-route transit is weak and depends on Närtrafik, Struntfiskeboa fire/overnight legality needs reserve-boundary verification, Årås services are seasonal/customer-dependent and there is no confirmed public potable water.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 9 runs from Böne kyrka to the Årås estate and mill area. It is an easy, road-heavy stage: asphalt at the start gives way to smaller gravel roads through rural villages, cultivated valley landscape and rolling forest. Knätte kyrka and nearby protected dry-meadow and swamp-forest areas provide cultural and natural context, while Varpaledet at Jogen offers a bathing/rest stop with toilet, grill and picnic facilities. The finish at Årås is a historic estate, mill and nature-reserve setting with parking, seasonal cafe and booked lodging, but no practical fixed-route public transport and no confirmed free public drinking water.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 9 GPX/API as the primary geometry. OSM relation 5607244 is a strong cross-check after orienting member ways by connectivity. Do not import Åsundenleden or Redvägsleden overlaps for section 9; only Änglaleden has a short OSM overlap.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for route continuity. Model Böne kyrka/church parking as the start access cluster. Model Årås säteri, Årås kvarn, Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar, Årås parking, cafe and hostel as one endpoint service/heritage cluster with aliases.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Böne kyrka and Böne parking/information as start access/heritage metadata, but suppress water/toilet/open-church service claims.
Import Varpaledet badplats as a bathing/rest cluster with toilet, grill, picnic tables and changing rooms; treat Jogen water as bathing water only.
Import Varpaledet parking as intermediate access metadata.
Import Struntfiskeboa shelter with overnight-use caveat; keep firepit pending until protected-area boundary and fire legality are verified.
Import Årås parking and Årås cafe/lodging as endpoint service metadata with seasonal/booking/customer caveats.
Keep Knätte and Kärnås protected areas mainly as rules/context unless exact facility objects are verified.
majorCaveats: Borås uses Årås säteri while OSM/E1/PDF and local Årås sources use Årås kvarn; treat as aliases, not separate endpoints.
Distance differs: 12 km official rounded municipal value vs 11.5 km Naturkartan/E1 and about 11.44 km computed linework.
Böne and Årås have no practical fixed-route transit at the trailheads; Närtrafik must be pre-booked and is weekday-window limited.
No reliable public potable water is confirmed on the section.
Årås, Knätte and Kärnås protected-area fire/camping/dog rules can override general allemansrätten.
Struntfiskeboa firepit and overnight-shelter status need legality/currentness checks before final import.
Naturkartan/Västkuststiftelsen quality-assurance warning remains relevant; no section-specific closure was found.
importReadiness.nextSafeStep: Commit this section packet, then proceed to section 10 six-agent research with special attention to Årås endpoint semantics, Södra Vätterleden overlap, Ryfors/Trollsjön/Stråken facilities, protected-area rules and Mullsjö transit access.
